name: BMS 结算管理系统
install: for d in . ./bms /agent/repos/bms; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/install.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/.cursor/install.sh"; done; echo 'bms/.cursor/install.sh not found' >&2; exit 1

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: for d in . ./bms /agent/repos/bms; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/run-backend.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/.cursor/run-backend.sh"; done; echo 'run-backend.sh not found' >&2; exit 1
terminals.description: Spring Boot API on :8080 (H2 file DB, auto-seeds demo data). Login admin/admin123; Open API X-Api-Key: dev-open-key.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: for d in . ./bms /agent/repos/bms; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/run-frontend.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/.cursor/run-frontend.sh"; done; echo 'run-frontend.sh not found' >&2; exit 1
terminals.description: Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173, proxies /api to the backend on :8080.
